rationale.Rye-Regular: Highest native hinted per-glyph cost among bytecode fonts in the screen and highest exploratory actual-demo first-paint savings in wave1. Decorative open-font stress case.
rationale.DoulosSIL-Regular: Second highest exploratory wave1 demo saving; practical non-decorative SIL serif contrast. Its interpreter buffer maxima are smaller than Vollkorn; test actual workload rather than infer from maxima.
rationale.Vollkorn-Medium: Simultaneously measured previous beneficial-font control; exploratory batches drifted enough that historical results cannot supply this comparison.

primary_endpoint: Absolute mean paired-block saving in demo first_paint draw_us, final versus master, at DPR2. DPR1, all other phases, reported sequence sums and GPU draw/submit/complete are retained secondary outcomes.

confirmation.order: 2-version Williams counterbalance, six font/DPR configurations rotated across blocks
confirmation.statistics: Process trial medians; paired block effects; mean and 95% paired-block bootstrap confidence interval, 10000 resamples. No optional stopping/exclusions.

pixels: New all-phase master/final/native actual-offset oracle captures at both DPRs, exact byte+atlas-count proof required before confirmation. Fixed Roboto controls unchanged by font overrides.
search_limit: Two exploratory waves, all attempts retained; no fonts synthesized or modified, no scene, text, zoom schedule, or cache parameters changed. Candidate selection is intentional and disclosed.
